classification.difficultyReason: Interpret the marked angle on a sketch (150° from the positive x-axis; 30° from the vertical, giving 60° inclination). Then find an exact gradient, use the intercept form, and rearrange to exact general form with surds.

content.prompt: Determine the equation of each straight line sketched below in exact general form.

answer.worked:
The marked angle is measured from the vertical.

$$\begin{align*}\theta&=90^{\circ}-30^{\circ}\\\theta&=60^{\circ}\\m&=\tan60^{\circ}\\m&=\sqrt3\\y-0&=\sqrt3\bigl(x-(-3)\bigr)\\y&=\sqrt3x+3\sqrt3\\\sqrt3x-y+3\sqrt3&=0\end{align*}$$
